sentences.en: people that were working in the government on Ukraine issues.
sentences.zh: 那些在政府处理乌克兰问题的人。

sentences.en: The Democrats are going to bring them forward in public on TV and ask them questions so they can say what they knew was going on with Ukraine and the aid and Trump pressuring them.
sentences.zh: 民主党人将把他们带到电视直播的公开场合，向他们提问，这样他们就能说出他们所知道的关于乌克兰、援助以及特朗普施压的情况。

sentences.en: Why are they public and why is that important?
sentences.zh: 为什么它们是公开的？这为什么很重要？

sentences.en: The Democrats are trying to build an argument for the country that there is a good reason to impeach the president.
sentences.zh: 民主党人正试图向全国论证，弹劾总统是有充分理由的。

sentences.en: And they think doing it in public where we can all watch on TV will have a greater impact.
sentences.zh: 他们认为在电视上公开进行，让大家都能看到，会有更大的影响。

sentences.en: What do you think about the fact that the Democrats think they need to have public hearings to convince people that what Trump did was wrong,
sentences.zh: 你觉得民主党人认为需要举行公开听证会来让人们相信特朗普的行为是错误的，这件事你怎么看？

sentences.en: that a lot of people in the country don't think that's a problem?
sentences.zh: 因为全国很多人并不认为这是一个问题？

sentences.en: Because they think that it's just doing, like, one thing.
sentences.zh: 因为他们认为这只是……做了一件事而已。

sentences.en: They know it's bad, but they don't think it's bad enough for him to get kicked out of office.
sentences.zh: 他们知道这不好，但他们认为还没严重到要把他赶下台的地步。

sentences.en: They definitely know it's bad, but I don't think they don't think it's bad enough.
sentences.zh: 他们绝对知道这不好，但我认为他们不觉得这严重到那种程度。

sentences.en: I think the most recent argument from Republicans would be that simply doing what he did is not enough to remove him from office.
sentences.zh: 我认为共和党人最近的论点是，仅仅做他所做的事，还不足以将他免职。

sentences.en: Do you have any more questions for Mike?
sentences.zh: 你还有什么问题要问迈克吗？

sentences.en: So when will we know if the president gets impeached, if he does get impeached?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果总统真的被弹劾，我们什么时候能知道？

sentences.en: When will, like, the public find out?
Well, my editors ask me this question every day.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的编辑每天都问我这个问题。

sentences.en: I think we may have an answer by December or January, so just a couple of months away.
sentences.zh: 我想我们可能在十二月或一月会有答案，也就是几个月后。

sentences.en: And if he's impeached, then this would be sent to the Senate where there would be a trial, six days a week, national television, the senators deciding whether to take out Trump.
sentences.zh: 如果他被弹劾，那么这将被送到参议院，在那里会进行审判，每周六天，全国电视直播，参议员们决定是否要罢免特朗普。

sentences.en: And when would that be decided by?
But the problem, Leo, is in Washington, everything always takes longer than we think it's going to.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，里奥，在华盛顿，所有事情总是比我们预想的要花更长时间。

sentences.en: So maybe it's the spring when we get some clarity.
sentences.zh: 所以也许要到春天我们才能清楚一些。

sentences.en: Leo, I want you to ask this question, which I think might be one of our last questions in this conversation with Mike.
sentences.zh: 里奥，我想让你问这个问题，我觉得这可能是我们和迈克谈话中的最后一个问题了。

sentences.en: What are we going to see this week in the coming weeks?
sentences.zh: 我们这周和未来几周会看到什么？

sentences.en: We're going to see the first one on Wednesday where a senior State Department official who had big concerns about what Trump was doing is going to testify publicly.
sentences.zh: 周三我们将看到第一场，一位对特朗普的行为有很大担忧的国务院高级官员将公开作证。

sentences.en: And then on Friday, another State Department official who was involved in all this stuff is going to testify in public again.
sentences.zh: 然后周五，另一位参与了所有这些事情的国务院官员也将再次公开作证。

sentences.en: And then next week, we'll see the same thing, but with different witnesses.
sentences.zh: 然后下周，我们会看到同样的情况，但会有不同的证人。

sentences.en: And this will be the Democrats trying to argue to the country why this is so important and why the president should be impeached.
sentences.zh: 这将是民主党人试图向全国论证为什么这如此重要，以及为什么总统应该被弹劾。

sentences.en: Leo, I have to leave and head to Washington to cover the first hearing that Mike just described.
sentences.zh: 里奥，我得走了，赶去华盛顿报道迈克刚才描述的第一场听证会。

sentences.en: But I'm curious, what has been the most interesting thing that you have learned here today from Mike Schmidt?
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇，今天从迈克·施密特那里学到的最有趣的事情是什么？

sentences.en: I think it's, I learned this and I didn't know it until today.
sentences.zh: 我想是……我学到了这个，在今天之前我不知道。

sentences.en: I didn't know about the Cold War between America and Russia.
sentences.zh: 我不知道美国和俄罗斯之间有冷战。

sentences.en: That's what I found that really interesting.
Yeah, it's a big part of the story, actually.
sentences.zh: 是的，实际上这是故事的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: Leo, what's your prediction about what's going to happen at the hearings?
sentences.zh: 里奥，你对听证会上会发生什么有什么预测吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think he's going to get impeached in the House, but he'll be okay.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为他在众议院会被弹劾，但他会没事的。

sentences.en: He won't, not enough people will vote in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 他不会……参议院里没有足够多的人投票支持。

sentences.en: So you think he's going to end up staying in office?
sentences.zh: 所以你认为他最终会留在职位上？
除非发生什么重大变化。

sentences.en: Leo, I think you know as much as I do now.
sentences.zh: 里奥，我想你现在知道的和我一样多了。

sentences.en: So, I think we're done here.
You say some of this stuff in a clearer way than anyone else I've heard.
sentences.zh: 你表达这些事情的方式比我听过的任何人都更清晰。

sentences.en: Do you want to show Mike the impeachment drawing?
sentences.zh: 你想给迈克看看那张弹劾画吗？

sentences.en: It's a person in a suit blowing a whistle.
sentences.zh: 是一个穿着西装的人在吹哨子。
留着唐纳德·特朗普的发型。
那是唐纳德·特朗普的发型？

sentences.en: I don't know, I thought so at firSt.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，起初我是这么想的。

sentences.en: With the words squee coming out of his mouth.
Leo, thank you so very much.
It was a pleasure to meet you.
And I look forward to someday coming on your podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我期待着有一天能上你的播客。

sentences.en: Six weeks after this episode ran, Bianca got back in touch with Leo.
sentences.zh: 这集节目播出六周后，比安卡联系了里奥。

sentences.en: So, tell me about listening to your story.
sentences.zh: 那么，跟我说说听你那个故事的事吧。

sentences.en: Well, I listened to it after it came out, and, um, I actually thought it was really good.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我在它发布后听了，嗯，我其实觉得它真的很好。

sentences.en: Are you still thinking about it?
I, I've, I, I've been following it a little.
sentences.zh: 我……我一直在稍微关注一下。

sentences.en: Um, have you been watching the impeachment hearings?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你有在看弹劾听证会吗？

sentences.en: Um, not, not, not very much.
Not very much, does that actually mean not at all?
sentences.zh: 没怎么看，那实际上意味着完全没看吗？

sentences.en: It's okay if you haven't watched them.
And so what other things are you interested in instead?
sentences.zh: 那你对什么其他事情感兴趣呢？

sentences.en: In our school, when you're in third grade, you get to choose instruments and play for the school band.
sentences.zh: 在我们学校，三年级的时候，你可以选择乐器并为学校乐队演奏。

sentences.en: So I'm, and I've been practicing that a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以我……我一直在练习那个。

sentences.en: So you've moved on from the impeachment to the trombone.
sentences.zh: 所以你已经从弹劾转向长号了。

sentences.en: Why did, why do you think you stopped following the impeachment?
sentences.zh: 为什么……你觉得你为什么停止关注弹劾了？

sentences.en: You know, I don't really know.
I think there's just a lot other, a lot of other things going on and it's kind of hard to keep following it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得还有很多其他事情在发生，一直关注它有点难。

sentences.en: Um, I'm going to follow the 2020 election.
I, I want to see who wins.
Do you have a favorite candidate?
I'm going to go with Joe Biden.
That's who you would vote for if you could?
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，你会投给他？

sentences.en: If I, if I could, I would either do Booker or Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 如果我……如果我可以，我会选布克或者乔·拜登。

sentences.en: What do you like about Booker?
Well, so he just seems nice.
Is that what you look for in a presidential candidate?
sentences.zh: 这就是你寻找总统候选人时所看重的吗？

sentences.en: And also he's the senator of New Jersey, so.
sentences.zh: 而且他还是新泽西州的参议员，所以。

sentences.en: Do you think you'll ever have your own podcast or do you want to do more podcasts?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你以后会做自己的播客吗？或者你想多做一些播客？

sentences.en: It would be fun to do another one.
sentences.zh: 再做一个应该会很有趣。

sentences.en: Do you know what you'd want it to be about?
sentences.zh: 你知道你想做关于什么内容的吗？

sentences.en: If we're ever covering Pokemon on the daily, I'll, I'll call you.
sentences.zh: 如果我们哪天要报道宝可梦的话，我会叫你的。

sentences.en: My brother said he would want to do the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥说他想做这个播客。

sentences.en: So, I could ask him if he could do the next kids episode.
sentences.zh: 所以，我可以问问他能不能做下一期儿童节目。

sentences.en: So you would want your brother to be on the next one and not you?
sentences.zh: 所以你是想让你哥哥上下一期，而不是你自己？

sentences.en: Um, it would, yeah, it would be fun if he could do one.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果他能做一期的话，那确实会很有趣。

sentences.en: Um, I would also like to do another one, but he would, but I would like him to do one so he can try it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我也想再做一期，但我希望他也能做一期，这样他可以尝试一下。

sentences.en: Um, you're such a nice brother, Leo.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你真是个好哥哥，里奥。

sentences.en: Well, anything else you'd like to say to the world?
sentences.zh: 那么，还有什么想对大家说的吗？

sentences.en: Thanks for catching me up to speed, Leo.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你让我了解了这些情况，里奥。

sentences.en: And good luck with the trombone.
This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。
他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？
他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
